properties.name: loomspan.observability.enabled
properties.description: Opt in to the servlet observability adapter.

properties.name: loomspan.observability.auth.api-key
properties.description: Sensitive operator credential. Supply 32 to 512 printable non-whitespace ASCII characters through external configuration.

properties.name: loomspan.observability.completion-grace-ttl
properties.description: Retention grace for completed trace artifacts; zero disables grace.

properties.name: loomspan.observability.trace-catalog-metadata-ttl
properties.description: Positive retention period for current-process finalized trace metadata.

properties.name: loomspan.connections
properties.description: Application-owned named AI connections. Values do not inherit or merge spring.ai.* properties.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.driver
properties.description: Spring AI protocol/client driver used by this concrete connection.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.api-key
properties.description: Sensitive credential. Supply it through an environment or external property placeholder.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.base-url
properties.description: Optional driver endpoint override; required for Ollama. OpenAI URLs ending in /v1 use /chat/completions; unversioned URLs use /v1/chat/completions. Values are not emitted in Loomspan diagnostics.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.headers
properties.description: Sensitive static headers supported only for the OpenAI driver.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.openai.organization-id
properties.description: OpenAI-only organization header value.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.openai.project-id
properties.description: OpenAI-only project header value.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.openai.chat-completions-path
properties.description: OpenAI-only chat-completions path override.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.anthropic.completions-path
properties.description: Anthropic-only messages/completions path override.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.anthropic.version
properties.description: Anthropic-only API version override.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.anthropic.beta-version
properties.description: Anthropic-only beta features header value.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.gemini.vertex-ai
properties.description: Enables Gemini Vertex AI mode; mutually exclusive with api-key mode.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.gemini.project-id
properties.description: Required Google Cloud project in Gemini Vertex AI mode.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.gemini.location
properties.description: Required Google Cloud location in Gemini Vertex AI mode.

properties.name: loomspan.connections.*.gemini.credentials-uri
properties.description: Optional Spring resource URI for credentials in Gemini Vertex AI mode.

properties.name: loomspan.models
properties.description: Framework model aliases referenced by YAML skills.

properties.name: loomspan.models.*.connection
properties.description: Required name of an entry in loomspan.connections.

properties.name: loomspan.models.*.provider-model
properties.description: Provider model ID applied to each request through the selected connection.

properties.name: loomspan.models.*.thinking-levels
properties.description: Thinking levels that skills selecting this model alias may request.
